data.text: Elena Vasquez believed she had uncovered a singular truth, a unique horror inflicted upon her.
data.delivery_notes: Resigned, detached tone; slow and deliberate pacing.

data.text: But the deepest terror wasn't the erasure of one life, but the quiet, relentless machinery that orchestrates countless others.
Her battle was just a ripple. The system, vast and indifferent, continued its work, a silent predator in the digital wilderness.
data.delivery_notes: Ominous and hollow; tone should drop into a final, unsettling stillness.
